latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Converter to MP4.

- Convert video files (AVI, MOV, MKV, WebM, up to 500MB) to 1080p MP4 without desktop software
- Simple cloud setup: automatically handles token generation and session management for new users
- Upload multiple video files and describe conversion tasks; supports fast batch and iterative workflows
- Real-time updates and clear user prompts during processing
- Supports a range of formats for input/output, including mp4, mov, avi, mkv, jpg, gif, and popular audio types
- Guides users with common workflows and troubleshooting for a smooth experience
